# AI Timeline

> AI Timeline is a structured reference covering the history of artificial intelligence from 1943 to the present. It documents 81 dated milestones grouped into 11 named eras, with dedicated pages for the people and organizations behind each breakthrough, plus editorial history guides. Content is free to read and cite with attribution to https://aitimeline.world.

The site is organized as a timeline of milestones, a set of historical eras, entity pages for people and organizations, and longer-form editorial guides. Every milestone page states what happened, when, who and which organizations were involved, and why it mattered.

## Eras

- [Theoretical Foundations (1943-1955)](https://aitimeline.world/era/origins)
- [The Birth of AI (1956-1969)](https://aitimeline.world/era/birth)
- [First AI Winter (1970-1979)](https://aitimeline.world/era/first-winter)
- [Expert Systems Boom (1980-1987)](https://aitimeline.world/era/expert-systems)
- [Second AI Winter (1988-1993)](https://aitimeline.world/era/second-winter)
- [Quiet Emergence (1994-2005)](https://aitimeline.world/era/emergence)
- [Deep Learning Dawn (2006-2011)](https://aitimeline.world/era/deep-learning)
- [Deep Learning Breakthrough (2012-2017)](https://aitimeline.world/era/breakthrough)
- [The Transformer Era (2018-2021)](https://aitimeline.world/era/transformer)
- [Generative AI Revolution (2022-2024)](https://aitimeline.world/era/generative)
- [The Agentic Era (2025-2026)](https://aitimeline.world/era/agentic)

## Key milestones

- [First Mathematical Model of Neural Networks (1943)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/mcculloch-pitts-1943)
- [Turing's 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (1950)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/turing-test-1950)
- [The Dartmouth Conference (1956)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/dartmouth-conference-1956)
- [The Perceptron (1957)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/perceptron-1957)
- [Perceptrons: The Book That Killed Neural Networks (1969)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/minsky-papert-perceptrons-1969)
- [The Lighthill Report (1973)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/lighthill-report-1973)
- [Backpropagation Rediscovered (1986)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/backprop-rediscovery-1986)
- [LeNet: Convolutional Neural Networks (1989)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/lenet-1989)
- [Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) (1997)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/lstm-1997)
- [Deep Blue Defeats Kasparov (1997)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/deep-blue-1997)
- [Deep Belief Networks: Hinton Revives Deep Learning (2006)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/deep-belief-networks-2006)
- [ImageNet: The Dataset That Changed Everything (2009)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/imagenet-2009)
- [AlexNet: The ImageNet Moment (2012)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/alexnet-2012)
- [AlphaGo Defeats Lee Sedol (2016)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/alphago-2016)
- [Attention Is All You Need: The Transformer (2017)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/transformer-2017)
- [GPT-3: The 175 Billion Parameter Leap (2020)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/gpt-3-2020)
- [AlphaFold 2: Protein Folding Solved (2020)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/alphafold-2-2020)
- [ChatGPT: AI Goes Mainstream (2022)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/chatgpt-2022)
- [GPT-4: Multimodal Intelligence (2023)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/gpt-4-2023)
- [The Rise of AI Agents (2025)](https://aitimeline.world/timeline/ai-agents-2025)
